label: 7-SEGMENT-4DIGIT-YOUNGSUN
description:
This is a part for the 4-Digit 7-segment LEDs from Young Sun.  Different from the Digikey LEDs, all 16 pins are used.
The LONGPADS Variant is used for a test jig, but you may like it because there is more pad to solder to. If you are concerned about routing space, the standard works just fine though.
